Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound on a Pearland, Texas roadway when the vehicle drifted into the northbound lane
and struck the front of Driver 2's vehicle in a low-speed head-on collision. Passenger was seated in the front
passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle and was confirmed present by both officers on scene and by statements from
independent witnesses. Several witnesses stated that the collision occurred as described by both drivers, and Driver
2 gave a consistent account of the sequence of events. Photographs taken at the scene show front-end damage to
both vehicles that corrseponds with the direction and force of impact reported. No prior damage to either vehicle was
observed or reported by the drivers. Passenger reported neck and back pain shortly after the collision and was
evaluated at the scene, where the complaint was considered consistent with the mechanism of a crash of this type.
Driver 1 identified the registered owner as a member of the same household, and the owner's records were reviewed
on scene. No citations were issued at the time of the report, and the investigation remains open pending further
statements.
</page>
